response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS baseline_quantity FROM order_averages) SELECT o.order_id, o.average_quantity, o.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.baseline_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity) IS NULL, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Because product_quantity is stored as text, nonblank values are valid numeric strings; NULL and blank or whitespace-only values are missing.
